rules: Must follow STAR format strictly: Situation -> Task -> Action -> Result
Lead with a strong, non-repetitive action verb (Spearheaded, Engineered, Orchestrated — not 'Worked on' or 'Helped')
Quantify impact with at least one hard metric (%, ₹, hours, users) positioned towards the end of the sentence
Mention tools/technologies/frameworks used explicitly
Keep to exactly 1 line per sub-point (no 2-line or 1.5-line points)
For internships: specify team size, project scope, and business impact
Include the client/industry context when the company name alone doesn't convey scale
iitb_conventions: Day 1 resumes usually have 1-2 experience entries (internships) with 3-4 sub-points each
Focus heavily on business outcomes and scale (e.g. 'driving $2M revenue' or 'affecting 10k users')

rules: Must follow Action + Methodology + Result structure
Explicitly mention the tech stack (languages, libraries, hardware) used
Quantify the performance improvement or result (e.g., 'achieved 95% accuracy', 'reduced latency by 200ms')
If it's a course project, mention the course name or professor briefly but focus on the work
No vague statements like 'learned a lot' or 'successfully completed'
iitb_conventions: Usually 3-4 key projects listed, often mixing course projects and independent/BTP projects
Technical depth is prioritized over business impact in this section

rules: Quantify the scale of responsibility (team size, budget managed, event footfall, number of colleges)
Describe unique initiatives taken, not just standard responsibilities
Focus on leadership and organizational impact (e.g. 'Mentored a team of 15', 'Managed a budget of ₹5 Lakhs')
For TA/Mentor roles: specify batch size and measurable outcome of your mentoring
iitb_conventions: Usually 2-4 PORs listed (e.g., Core Committee Member, Institute Secretary, Teaching Assistant)
Emphasis is on demonstrating leadership, teamwork, and ability to handle scale

rules: State the rank/percentile clearly (e.g., 'All India Rank 45 among 1.5 Lakh candidates')
Mention the specific olympiad, scholarship, or exam
Do not use full sentences; use punchy phrases
Include year of achievement
iitb_conventions: Includes JEE Advanced rank, KVPY, NTSE, Olympiads, and Institute Academic Awards (e.g., AP grade, Institute Academic Prize)

rules: Highlight competitive success (e.g., 'Secured 1st position among 50 teams')
Include inter-IIT, national, or international level achievements
Mention specific skills demonstrated (e.g., debating, sports, cultural arts)
Quantify participation scale if applicable
iitb_conventions: Often categorized into Sports, Cultural, and Technical
Inter-IIT achievements and Inter-Hostel (GC) achievements are highly valued
